QUESTION: Which simplicial sets are strict inner Kan complexes, i.e. those in which every inner horn has a unique filler? Characterize them in terms of categories.

ATOM: A simplicial set $X$ is a strict inner Kan complex if and only if $X$ is isomorphic to $N\mathbf{C}$ for some small category $\mathbf{C}$.
KEY POINTS:
1. A simplicial set is a strict inner Kan complex exactly when it is isomorphic to the nerve $N\mathbf{C}$
2. of some small category $\mathbf{C}$

ANSWER TO GRADE:
A simplicial set is a strict inner Kan complex exactly when it is isomorphic to the nerve of a (small) category. Conversely, every nerve of a category has unique fillers for all inner horns.
